AppointmentsCalendar.cancelAppointment.reason: Cancels a booked appointment. insertAppointment books the same shift again while it is still free.
AppointmentsCalendar.cancelAppointment.notes: Undo: read the appointment's shiftId (and note) beforehand, then call insertAppointment(personId=$args.personId, body.shiftId=<that shift>). The new booking has a new id, and the slot may be taken by someone else in between.

AppointmentsCalendar.insertAppointment.reason: Books an appointment in a shift for a person. AppointmentsCalendar.cancelAppointment cancels it.
AppointmentsCalendar.insertAppointment.notes: Undo: find the new appointment id with AppointmentsCalendar.getBookingsList(calendarContext, personId) (likely calendarCallEnrolledId), because the insert returns nothing. Then call cancelAppointment(callId=<that id>, personId=$args.personId). Use a test calendar or shift, because staff see the booking until it is cancelled.

AppointmentsCalendar.updateAppointment.reason: Moves a booking to another shift (books the new one and cancels the old). Calling it again with the original shift moves it back.
AppointmentsCalendar.updateAppointment.notes: Undo: read the original shiftId before the call, find the new appointment id with getBookingsList, then call updateAppointment(callId=<new id>, personId, body.shiftId=<original shift>). This works only while the original slot is still free, and the appointment gets a new id.

Attachments.deleteUploadedAttachment.reason: Deletes the upload staging record (uploadId) once an upload has finished, or to abort one no longer needed; the attachment itself stays, and only the user who started the upload may call it.
Attachments.deleteUploadedAttachment.notes: On an upload still waiting for its blob, that upload can no longer be completed and the attachment has to be inserted again; only call it on the test's own uploadId.

Attachments.postGenericAttachmentMetadat.reason: Inserts the metadata of a new attachment of the given type (the Location header leads to its blob upload); the attachments API has no operation that deletes an attachment.
Attachments.postGenericAttachmentMetadat.notes: deleteUploadedAttachment only removes the upload staging record, not the attachment.

Attachments.uploadAttachment.reason: Uploads the file of an attachment whose metadata was inserted, completing an attachment staff see; no operation deletes attachments.

Attachments.validateAttachment.reason: Sets an attachment's valid flag (validFlag 0 or 1); the previous flag can be read with getAttachmentMetadata and written back.
Attachments.validateAttachment.notes: The spec only talks about setting the flag to 1 and answers 422 when the change is not allowed, so writing 0 back may be refused; validity is something staff act on, so use a test attachment nobody relies on.

Auth.checkLogon.reason: Verifies the Basic credentials, possibly opening a session or logging an access.

Auth.getJWT.reason: Issues a JWT for the already authenticated session.

Auth.login.reason: Logs in and opens an Esse3 session.

Auth.logout.notes: Invalidates the session the test is using; run it last or with its own session.

Auth.refreshJWT.reason: Issues a refreshed JWT for the given token.

Auth.setCacheParameters.reason: Changes only the cache settings of the current session.

Auth.setLanguageCode.reason: Changes only the session language used for descriptions.

BadgeImport.postImportAward.reason: Imports one or more badge awards, which Esse3 records as university titles of the holders (batch import); no operation deletes them.

BadgeImport.postImportBadgeClass.reason: Imports one or more badge classes into Esse3's university title types (batch import); no operation deletes them.

BadgeImport.putBadgeIssuing.reason: Records that a badge was issued or cancelled on the external platform, in answer to an Esse3 request; the holder and staff see it.

CareerUpdate.deletePreview.reason: Deletes a career-update preview prepared by staff; it cannot be restored.
CareerUpdate.deletePreview.notes: Rerunning the bulk procedure could rebuild an unexecuted preview, but with a new id and without the per-row flags. For an executed preview, the processing log is lost.

CareerUpdate.executeUpdateCareers.reason: Executes a career-update preview, changing students' careers.

CareerUpdate.postAddTeachingActivityOffe.reason: The bulk invocation of AGG_AD_OFF only builds a career-update preview (staging rows); careers change only when CareerUpdate.executeUpdateCareers runs it, and CareerUpdate.deletePreview removes the preview.
CareerUpdate.postAddTeachingActivityOffe.notes: Undo: CareerUpdate.deletePreview(careerUpdateId) on the new preview. Its id is returned only in the Link header (the response is empty), so find it as the newest CareerUpdate.getCareerUpdateHeaders entry with procedureCode AGG_AD_OFF. Never call executeUpdateCareers in between. The spec's flow is POST -> preview -> (elabora) -> esegui -> delete.

CareerUpdate.postAttendance.reason: The bulk invocation of FREQ only builds a career-update preview (staging rows); careers change only when CareerUpdate.executeUpdateCareers runs it, and CareerUpdate.deletePreview removes the preview.
CareerUpdate.postAttendance.notes: Undo: CareerUpdate.deletePreview(careerUpdateId) on the new preview. Its id is returned only in the Link header (the response is empty), so find it as the newest CareerUpdate.getCareerUpdateHeaders entry with procedureCode FREQ. Never call executeUpdateCareers in between. The spec's flow is POST -> preview -> (elabora) -> esegui -> delete.

CareerUpdate.postRemoveAttendance.reason: The bulk invocation of RIMUOVI_FREQ only builds a career-update preview (staging rows); careers change only when CareerUpdate.executeUpdateCareers runs it, and CareerUpdate.deletePreview removes the preview.
CareerUpdate.postRemoveAttendance.notes: Undo: CareerUpdate.deletePreview(careerUpdateId) on the new preview. Its id is returned only in the Link header (the response is empty), so find it as the newest CareerUpdate.getCareerUpdateHeaders entry with procedureCode RIMUOVI_FREQ. Never call executeUpdateCareers in between. The spec's flow is POST -> preview -> (elabora) -> esegui -> delete.

CareerUpdate.postSEG.reason: The bulk invocation of SEG only builds a career-update preview (staging rows); careers change only when CareerUpdate.executeUpdateCareers runs it, and CareerUpdate.deletePreview removes the preview.
CareerUpdate.postSEG.notes: Undo: CareerUpdate.deletePreview(careerUpdateId) on the new preview. Its id is returned only in the Link header (the response is empty), so find it as the newest CareerUpdate.getCareerUpdateHeaders entry with procedureCode SEG. Never call executeUpdateCareers in between. The spec's flow is POST -> preview -> (elabora) -> esegui -> delete.

CareerUpdate.postSubstitution.reason: The bulk invocation of SOST only builds a career-update preview (staging rows); careers change only when CareerUpdate.executeUpdateCareers runs it, and CareerUpdate.deletePreview removes the preview.
CareerUpdate.postSubstitution.notes: Undo: CareerUpdate.deletePreview(careerUpdateId) on the new preview. Its id is returned only in the Link header (the response is empty), so find it as the newest CareerUpdate.getCareerUpdateHeaders entry with procedureCode SOST. Never call executeUpdateCareers in between. The spec's flow is POST -> preview -> (elabora) -> esegui -> delete.

CareerUpdate.putAddTeachingActivityOffer.reason: Runs the AGG_AD_OFF career update for one student.
CareerUpdate.putAddTeachingActivityOffer.notes: The per-student invocation runs the engine at once (spec: 'il motore viene lanciato in modo contestuale') and returns its log, changing the student's career directly.

CareerUpdate.putAttendanceByStudent.reason: Records attendance (FREQ) in one student's career.
CareerUpdate.putAttendanceByStudent.notes: The per-student invocation runs the engine at once (spec: 'il motore viene lanciato in modo contestuale') and returns its log, changing the student's career directly.

CareerUpdate.putRemoveAttendanceByStuden.reason: Removes attendance (RIMUOVI_FREQ) from one student's career.
CareerUpdate.putRemoveAttendanceByStuden.notes: The per-student invocation runs the engine at once (spec: 'il motore viene lanciato in modo contestuale') and returns its log, changing the student's career directly.

CareerUpdate.putSEGByStudent.reason: Runs the SEG career update for one student.
CareerUpdate.putSEGByStudent.notes: The per-student invocation runs the engine at once (spec: 'il motore viene lanciato in modo contestuale') and returns its log, changing the student's career directly.

CareerUpdate.putSubstitutionByStudent.reason: Substitutes activities (SOST) in one student's career.
CareerUpdate.putSubstitutionByStudent.notes: The per-student invocation runs the engine at once (spec: 'il motore viene lanciato in modo contestuale') and returns its log, changing the student's career directly.

CareerUpdate.setProcessingDetailFlag.reason: Toggles the 'process' flag of one row of a staff preview. The previous flag can be read and set back with the same call.
CareerUpdate.setProcessingDetailFlag.notes: processFlag is read as 1/0 and processNow takes a boolean, so the restore needs that conversion. If the preview is executed before the undo, the row is applied to a real career, so only use a test preview.

Careers.careerClosure.reason: Closes a student's career with a closure reason and date; no operation reopens a career.
Careers.careerClosure.notes: Catastrophic for the test account; no reopen operation exists in this API.

Careers.putCanteenBand.reason: Sets the student's canteen fee band for an academic year; the previous band can be read from getAnnualEnrollment and written back.
Careers.putCanteenBand.notes: The band must pass the FASCIA_MENSA context rules, so writing the old band back could be refused if the rules changed; the band affects what the student pays, so use a test career.

Careers.putCareerByStudent.reason: Sets the student's protocol number on the career record; the previous number can be read from getCareerByStudent and written back.
Careers.putCareerByStudent.notes: body.protocolNumber is a non-null string, so a career with no protocol number cannot be put back exactly; skip it in that case.

Careers.putEnrollmentDateAndExemptionTyp.reason: Sets the enrollment date and fee exemption type of an annual enrollment; the previous values can be read from getAnnualEnrollment and written back.
Careers.putEnrollmentDateAndExemptionTyp.notes: The call takes only the matricola, so the undo first resolves studentId with Careers.getCareers(studentMatricola = $args.matricola), then reads Careers.getAnnualEnrollment(studentId, academicYear = $args.academicYear) and writes [0].exemptionTypeCode and [0].enrollmentDate back with this call. Esse3 may recalculate fees from the exemption type; restoring the old value should recalculate them back, but run it only on a test career.

Careers.putEnrollmentDateAndExemptionTyp.reason: Sets the enrollment date and fee exemption type of an annual enrollment; the previous values can be read from getAnnualEnrollment and written back.
Careers.putEnrollmentDateAndExemptionTyp.notes: Restore [0].enrollmentDate into body.enrollmentDate too. Esse3 may recalculate fees from the exemption type; restoring the old value should recalculate them back, but run it only on a test career.

Careers.putGraduationWaiting.reason: Sets the awaiting-graduation flag and date on a student's career; the previous values can be read from getCareerByStudent and written back.
Careers.putGraduationWaiting.notes: Restore degreeAwardDate into body.degreeAwardDate too (it must be null when the flag is 0). The body must identify the student by studentId (or matricola, then read studentId from getCareers). The flag may be read by graduation workflows, so use a test career.

Careers.putStudentTypeCode.reason: Sets the student type code of an annual enrollment; the previous code can be read from getAnnualEnrollment and written back.
Careers.putStudentTypeCode.notes: The spec accepts null, so an empty previous code can be written back too.

ChoiceRules.patchChoiceRegulation.reason: The only allowed change is the regulation's state (A active / B draft), which can be read beforehand and written back with the same call.
ChoiceRules.patchChoiceRegulation.notes: Until the undo runs, the regulation's state decides whether students can fill in study plans under it, so use a regulation nobody is using. Esse3 may refuse some transitions, e.g. back to draft once plans are linked. The X (deleted) state read back is not a settable value.

ChoiceRules.putLinkedPlansCount.reason: Computes counts of plans linked to a choice regulation; the body only selects which counts to show.
ChoiceRules.putLinkedPlansCount.notes: Sent as PUT, but the body (Esse3PlansCountsFilters) holds only display flags.

Communications.postCommunication.reason: Creates and sends a communication (e-mail, SMS or app notification) to recipients.
Communications.postCommunication.notes: Can target all students, teachers or staff; must never run.

Competitions.putCompetitionEnrollment.reason: Enrols a person in an admission test; the API has no operation to withdraw it.
Competitions.putCompetitionEnrollment.notes: No operation of the Esse3 API withdraws a candidate from an admission test; enrolment can also generate the admission-fee invoice and a ranking entry.

Competitions.putCompetitionRanking.reason: Imports the ranking of an admission test from JSON, overwriting official results.

Competitions.putCompetitionRankingFile.reason: Imports the ranking of an admission test from a txt or csv file, overwriting official results.

Competitions.putCompetitionRankingsFile.reason: Imports the admission rankings of a competition from a txt or csv file.

Competitions.putRankingTestDetail.reason: Imports a ranking of an admission test detail from JSON.

Competitions.putRankingTestDetailFile.reason: Imports a single ranking of an admission test from a txt or csv file.

DegreeAward.postCommitteeApplication.reason: Submits the student's degree application, which the student office acts on.
DegreeAward.postCommitteeApplication.notes: putCancelCommitteeApplication can cancel it, but the cancelled application stays on record and staff are involved.

DegreeAward.postThesisAttachmentMetadata.reason: Inserts the metadata of a thesis attachment, which staff see.
DegreeAward.postThesisAttachmentMetadata.notes: The insert returns the upload URL only in a Location header. Attachments.deleteUploadedAttachment can abort a pending upload, but the spec doesn't say this removes the attachment, so no exact undo is documented.

DegreeAward.postThesisIntoCommitteeAppli.reason: Adds a thesis to the degree application, which supervisors and staff see; there is no matching delete.

DegreeAward.putAntiplagiarismData.reason: Records anti-plagiarism results and approval for a thesis attachment.
DegreeAward.putAntiplagiarismData.notes: The spec says it may also approve the final thesis attachment and with it the thesis, a decision staff act on.

DegreeAward.putThesisDiscussionMode.reason: Sets a thesis's consultation mode code. The previous code can be read with getThesisByThesisId and written back with the same call.
DegreeAward.putThesisDiscussionMode.notes: Use a test thesis, because the library and staff read this code while it is changed.

DegreeAward.putThesisRelation.reason: Adds supervisors to a thesis, which the supervisors see.
DegreeAward.putThesisRelation.notes: There is no operation to remove a supervisor from a thesis.

ExamsCalendar.deleteEsacomChild.reason: Removes a child activity from a common exam. putEsacomChild with the same keys and the old flags puts it back.
ExamsCalendar.deleteEsacomChild.notes: The undo body (mutualFlag, logConditionFlag) must be read beforehand with ExamsCalendar.getEsacomChild. Until it is restored, the child course does not share the parent's exam calls, so use a common exam nobody relies on. forceFlag may cascade to existing calls.

ExamsCalendar.deleteExamCall.reason: Deletes an exam call, possibly forcing the cancellation of its bookings; it cannot be restored.
ExamsCalendar.deleteExamCall.notes: postExamCall could recreate an empty call with the same data, but with a new callId. With forceCancellation > 0 it also cancels bookings and publications that can't be restored.

ExamsCalendar.deleteExamCallEnrolledList.reason: Cancels a student's exam booking. postExamCallEnrolledList books it again while booking is open.
ExamsCalendar.deleteExamCallEnrolledList.notes: The undo body needs activityChoiceId (and callLogId/examType if set), read beforehand with getEnrolledExamCall(courseOfStudyId, activityId, callId, studentId). Only run before the booking deadline. Rebooking gets a new applicationListId and may change the student's position in the list.

ExamsCalendar.importSystemLog.reason: Imports rooms/commitments from the external logistics system (batch import).

ExamsCalendar.postExamCall.reason: Creates an exam call that ExamsCalendar.deleteExamCall removes again, as long as nobody books it in the meantime.
ExamsCalendar.postExamCall.notes: Undo: find the new callId with ExamsCalendar.getExamCalls(courseOfStudyId, activityId), matching the date from the body (the response is empty), then call deleteExamCall(courseOfStudyId, activityId, callId, forceCancellation=0). Use a test activity, because students of the course can see and book the call until it is deleted.

ExamsCalendar.postExamCallEnrolledList.reason: Books a student onto an exam call. ExamsCalendar.deleteExamCallEnrolledList cancels the booking before the booking deadline.
ExamsCalendar.postExamCallEnrolledList.notes: Undo: deleteExamCallEnrolledList(courseOfStudyId, activityId, callId, studentId), where studentId is the booked student's career id (stuId). It is neither an argument nor in the (empty) result, so the harness must supply the test student's stuId. It can also be read from ExamsCalendar.getExamCallEnrolledList. Only run before the booking deadline.

ExamsCalendar.putAcknowledgmentOfReceipt.reason: Accepts or rejects the published exam outcome (presa visione), which the teacher acts on for the minutes.
Accepts or rejects the published exam outcome of a booking (presa visione), which the teacher acts on.

ExamsCalendar.putApplicationListOutcome.reason: Records an exam outcome (grade) for a student.

ExamsCalendar.putEsacomChild.reason: Adds a child activity to a common exam. ExamsCalendar.deleteEsacomChild with the same keys removes it.
ExamsCalendar.putEsacomChild.notes: Exact only if the child did not exist before (check with getEsacomChild). If it did, the PUT updates it, and the undo should restore mutualFlag/logConditionFlag instead of deleting. Use a common exam nobody relies on.

ExamsCalendar.putExamCall.reason: Updates an exam call's details. The previous values can be read with ExamsCalendar.getExamCall and written back with the same call.
ExamsCalendar.putExamCall.notes: Undo: read getExamCall(courseOfStudyId, activityId, callId) first and putExamCall again with the old values of the changed fields. The restore form can't hold a whole body. Return code 11 ('Errore nell'invio della comunicazione') shows changes can e-mail booked students, so only use a call with no bookings.

ExamsCalendar.putExamCallPublication.reason: Publishes the outcomes of an exam call to its students, who are notified.

ExamsCalendar.putModifyBooking.reason: Changes the exam type and compensatory measures of an existing booking. The previous values can be read with getEnrolledExamCall and written back with the same call.
ExamsCalendar.putModifyBooking.notes: The restore covers the exam type only. If compensatoryMeasures were changed, write back the list read from getEnrolledExamCall too. Needs an existing test booking.

ExamsCalendar.putShiftPublication.reason: Publishes the outcomes of an exam shift to its students, who are notified.

ExamsCalendar.updateCommitment.reason: Updates commitments coming from the external logistics system.

Logging.putTlogSessions.reason: Sets a temporary log-level override for a session, which only affects server logging and expires after its timeout.
Logging.putTlogSessions.notes: Only call it with the test's own session id and a short llevelMinutesTimeout; a verbose level makes the server log more.

Logistics.putSyllabusTeachingActivity.reason: Overwrites syllabus fields of a teaching activity's logistics. The previous values can be read and written back with the same call.
Logistics.putSyllabusTeachingActivity.notes: Undo: before the call, read the current syllabus (Logistics.getTeachingActivityLogWithSyllabus or Transcript.getSyllabusTeachingActivityRecordBookRow), then call putSyllabusTeachingActivity again with the same keys and the old syllabusFields, publication flag and SDG list. The restore form can't hold a list of fields. The syllabus is public while changed, so use a test activity.

Logistics.syncSystemLog.reason: Runs a synchronisation of classrooms and buildings with the external logistics system.

Offer.patchContextualizedTeachingActivit.reason: Only sets the activity's Moodle course URL, which can be read beforehand and written back with the same call.
Offer.patchContextualizedTeachingActivit.notes: If the old value was null, a PATCH with null may be read as 'no change'. Esse3 uses special null markers such as #!N!# elsewhere, so check this before relying on the undo.

Offer.putActivityPlanCount.reason: Returns counts of study plans linked to a generic teaching activity for the filters in the body.
Offer.putActivityPlanCount.notes: Sent as PUT but the body is a filter object and the response is a count (404 when no data); description is empty, so a reviewer may prefer irreversible. TECHNICAL_USER only.

PersonalData.careerClosure.reason: Closes a student's career with a closure reason and date; no operation reopens a career.

PersonalData.deleteCareerAttachmentMetad.reason: Deletes an attachment of a career segment.
PersonalData.deleteCareerAttachmentMetad.notes: It could be re-created by downloading the blob first and inserting and uploading it again, but the copy gets a new id and loses its validation state and dates, so it is not an exact undo.

PersonalData.deleteExternalSubject.notes: putExternalSubject could create a similar subject, but with a new id and without the data linked to the old one, so it is not an exact undo.

PersonalData.deletePersonalDocumentAttac.notes: Re-inserting it (postIdentityDocumentAttachmentMetadata plus the blob upload) gives a new id and loses its validation state, so it is not an exact undo.

PersonalData.dismissEmail.reason: Decommissions a person's institutional e-mail address; no operation reinstates it.
PersonalData.dismissEmail.notes: putStudentAteEmail could write the address back, but it is not clear that Esse3 accepts a dismissed address again, and the dismissal is likely propagated to the university's account and mailbox systems.

PersonalData.dismissEmailByAteEmail.reason: Decommissions an institutional e-mail address (looked up by the address itself); no operation reinstates it.
PersonalData.dismissEmailByAteEmail.notes: putStudentAteEmail could write the address back, but it is not clear that Esse3 accepts a dismissed address again, and the dismissal is likely propagated to the university's account and mailbox systems.

PersonalData.insertCompensatoryMeasuresH.reason: Adds compensatory measures (exam accommodations) to a disability declaration; no operation deletes a measure.
PersonalData.insertCompensatoryMeasuresH.notes: The update calls could set the measure's state or end date, but the measure record would remain.

PersonalData.postAuthorizedAttachmentMet.reason: Inserts attachment metadata for an authorized person; no operation deletes this kind of attachment.

PersonalData.postAuthorizedPersonalDocum.reason: Inserts attachment metadata for an authorized person's identity document; no operation deletes this kind of attachment.
PersonalData.postAuthorizedPersonalDocum.notes: deletePersonalDocumentAttachmentMetadata takes a person's identity document id (docPersId); it is not clear that an authorized person's document id (personalDataDocAuthorizationId) is accepted there. If it is, this becomes reversible like postIdentityDocumentAttachmentMetadata.

PersonalData.postCompensatoryMeasuresHan.reason: Adds compensatory measures (exam accommodations) to a disability declaration; no operation deletes a measure.
PersonalData.postCompensatoryMeasuresHan.notes: The update calls could set the measure's state or end date, but the measure record would remain.

PersonalData.postForeignTitleAttachmentM.reason: Inserts a foreign degree attachment; no operation deletes it.

PersonalData.postHandicapDeclarationAtta.reason: Inserts an attachment to a disability declaration that staff evaluate; no operation deletes it.

PersonalData.postHighSchoolGraduationAtt.reason: Inserts a high school diploma attachment; no operation deletes it.

PersonalData.postIdentityDocumentAttachm.reason: Inserts an identity document attachment, which deletePersonalDocumentAttachmentMetadata can remove once its id is found in the listing.
PersonalData.postIdentityDocumentAttachm.notes: The insert returns no body (only a Location header), so the undo needs two steps: list getIdentityDocumentAttachmentMetadata(personId, identityDocumentTypeCode, personalDocumentId) before and after to find the new attachmentId, then call deletePersonalDocumentAttachmentMetadata(personalDocumentId = $args.body.personalDocumentId, attachmentId = <new id>, personId = $args.personId). Use a test person's document, since staff validate these attachments.

PersonalData.postItalianTitleAttachmentM.reason: Inserts an Italian degree attachment; no operation deletes it.

PersonalData.postMatricolaAttachmentMeta.reason: Inserts an attachment of the student's career (matricola), which deleteCareerAttachmentMetadata can remove once its id is found in the listing.
PersonalData.postMatricolaAttachmentMeta.notes: The insert returns no body, so the undo needs two steps: list getMatricolaAttachmentMetadata(studentId) before and after to find the new attachmentId, read matId from getCareerByStudent(studentId), then call deleteCareerAttachmentMetadata(matId, attachmentId). This assumes matricola attachments are the career-segment attachments that delete removes; check on a test student first.

PersonalData.postPersonPhotoAttachmentMe.reason: Inserts a person's photo attachment, which staff validate; no operation deletes or lists it.

PersonalData.putCanteenBand.reason: Sets the student's canteen fee band for an academic year; the previous band can be read from getAnnualEnrollment and written back.
PersonalData.putCanteenBand.notes: The band must pass the FASCIA_MENSA context rules, so writing the old band back could be refused if the rules changed; the band affects what the student pays, so use a test career. The anagrafica-service-v2 career endpoints are marked deprecated, to be removed on 31/01/2026; the call may already fail with 404, in which case use the carriere-service-v1 twin.

PersonalData.putCareerByStudent.reason: Sets the student's protocol number on the career record; the previous number can be read from getCareerByStudent and written back.
PersonalData.putCareerByStudent.notes: body.protocolNumber is a non-null string, so a career with no protocol number cannot be put back exactly; skip it in that case. The anagrafica-service-v2 career endpoints are marked deprecated, to be removed on 31/01/2026; the call may already fail with 404, in which case use the carriere-service-v1 twin.

PersonalData.putDomicilePhone.reason: Sets a person's domicile phone number and prefix; the previous values can be read from getPerson and written back.
PersonalData.putDomicilePhone.notes: Restore domicileInternationalPrefix into body.prefix too. Both the domicile and the other phone operation are described as 'aggiornamento telefono di residenza' in the spec, so check which field actually changes. Skip the test if the old number is null and the server rejects null.

PersonalData.putEnrollmentDateAndExempti.reason: Sets the enrollment date and fee exemption type of an annual enrollment; the previous values can be read from getAnnualEnrollment and written back.
PersonalData.putEnrollmentDateAndExempti.notes: The call takes only the matricola, so the undo first resolves studentId with PersonalData.getCareers(studentMatricola = $args.matricola), then reads PersonalData.getAnnualEnrollment(studentId, academicYear = $args.academicYear) and writes [0].exemptionTypeCode and [0].enrollmentDate back with this call. Esse3 may recalculate fees from the exemption type; restoring the old value should recalculate them back, but run it only on a test career. The anagrafica-service-v2 career endpoints are marked deprecated, to be removed on 31/01/2026; the call may already fail with 404, in which case use the carriere-service-v1 twin.

PersonalData.putEnrollmentDateAndExempti.reason: Sets the enrollment date and fee exemption type of an annual enrollment; the previous values can be read from getAnnualEnrollment and written back.
PersonalData.putEnrollmentDateAndExempti.notes: Restore [0].enrollmentDate into body.enrollmentDate too. Esse3 may recalculate fees from the exemption type; restoring the old value should recalculate them back, but run it only on a test career. The anagrafica-service-v2 career endpoints are marked deprecated, to be removed on 31/01/2026; the call may already fail with 404, in which case use the carriere-service-v1 twin.

PersonalData.putExternalSubject.reason: Creates an external subject when the body has no externalSubjectId, fiscal code or abbreviatedId (otherwise updates one); a created subject can be removed with deleteExternalSubject.
PersonalData.putExternalSubject.notes: Only the create mode is reversible this way. In update mode the read (getExternalSubject) lacks several body fields (phone, fax, mobile, prefixes), so an update cannot be put back exactly; test with a new subject only.

PersonalData.putExternalSubjectConsents.reason: Sets an external subject's privacy consent flags; the previous flags can be read with getExternalSubjectConsents and written back with the same call.
PersonalData.putExternalSubjectConsents.notes: Undo: before the call read getExternalSubjectConsents(externalSubjectId, webProcedureCode), then call this operation again with, for each consent in the body, consentTypeCode = consentTypesConsentTypeCode and the old consentFlag and startDate. Consent changes are probably logged with their date, so the history keeps the toggle; only run it on a test external subject, for example one created with putExternalSubject.

PersonalData.putGraduationWaiting.reason: Sets the awaiting-graduation flag and date on a student's career; the previous values can be read from getCareerByStudent and written back.
PersonalData.putGraduationWaiting.notes: Restore degreeAwardDate into body.degreeAwardDate too (it must be null when the flag is 0). The body must identify the student by studentId (or matricola, then read studentId from getCareers). The flag may be read by graduation workflows, so use a test career. The anagrafica-service-v2 career endpoints are marked deprecated, to be removed on 31/01/2026; the call may already fail with 404, in which case use the carriere-service-v1 twin.

PersonalData.putHandicapDeclaration.reason: Sets the state, percentage and dates of a disability declaration (by id, by type, or the most recent one); the previous values can be read and written back.
PersonalData.putHandicapDeclaration.notes: Undo: the call returns the updated declarations; before it, read getHandicapDeclaration(personId, handicapDeclarationId) and afterwards call putHandicapDeclarationById(personId, declarationId) with the old handicapDeclarationState, handicapPercentage, startDate and endDate. Without handicapDeclarationId the target is 'the most recent non-cancelled declaration', so pass the id to know which one changed. State transitions may be constrained, and staff evaluate these declarations, so use a test person.

PersonalData.putHandicapDeclarationById.reason: Sets the state, percentage and dates of a disability declaration; the previous values can be read with getHandicapDeclarationById and written back.
PersonalData.putHandicapDeclarationById.notes: Restore handicapPercentage, startDate and endDate the same way (same field names in the read and the body). State transitions may be constrained, and staff evaluate these declarations, so use a test person.

PersonalData.putMobilePhone.reason: Sets the person's mobile phone number; setting the previous number back undoes it.
PersonalData.putMobilePhone.notes: The setter takes a body object (Esse3MobileParameter.mobilePhone), so 'into' names a body field. If the original number is null the restore may be rejected, so skip the test in that case. Any SMS the university sends during the test would go to the test number.

PersonalData.putPersonCompensatoryMeasur.reason: Sets the state and dates of a compensatory measure of a disability declaration; the previous values can be read and written back with the same call.
PersonalData.putPersonCompensatoryMeasur.notes: Undo: before the call read getPersonCompensatoryMeasuresHandicapDeclaration(personId, handicapDeclarationId), pick the element whose handicapDeclarationMeasuresId (or compensatoryMeasureCode) matches the target, and call this operation again with its compensatoryMeasureState, measureStartDate and measureEndDate. The measures grant a student exam accommodations that staff act on, so use a test person.

PersonalData.putResidencePhone.reason: Sets a person's residence phone number and prefix; the previous values can be read from getPerson and written back.
PersonalData.putResidencePhone.notes: Restore residenceInternationalPrefix into body.prefix too. Both the residence and the other phone operation are described as 'aggiornamento telefono di residenza' in the spec, so check which field actually changes. Skip the test if the old number is null and the server rejects null.

PersonalData.putStudentAteEmail.reason: Sets a student's institutional e-mail address; the previous address can be read from getPerson and written back.
PersonalData.putStudentAteEmail.notes: The address cannot be set to null, so a person with no institutional address cannot be put back; skip that case. The address may be synchronized to the university's account systems while it is changed, so use a test person.

PersonalData.putStudentConsents.reason: Sets a student's privacy consent flags; the previous flags can be read with getStudentConsents and written back with the same call.
PersonalData.putStudentConsents.notes: Undo: before the call read getStudentConsents(personId, webProcedureCode, studentId, academicYearId), then call this operation again with, for each consent in the body, consentTypeCode = consentTypesConsentTypeCode and the old consentFlag and startDate. Consent changes are probably logged with their date, so the history keeps the toggle; only run it on a test person, since a consent is the person's own declaration.

PersonalData.putStudentEmail.reason: Sets a student's personal e-mail address (null allowed); the previous address can be read from getPerson and written back.
PersonalData.putStudentEmail.notes: Mail the university sends during the test would go to the test address; use a test person.

PersonalData.putStudentTypeCode.reason: Sets the student type code of an annual enrollment; the previous code can be read from getAnnualEnrollment and written back.
PersonalData.putStudentTypeCode.notes: The spec accepts null, so an empty previous code can be written back too. The anagrafica-service-v2 career endpoints are marked deprecated, to be removed on 31/01/2026; the call may already fail with 404, in which case use the carriere-service-v1 twin.

PersonalData.putTitles.reason: Imports (inserts or updates) the study titles of one or more people in bulk; no operation deletes a title.

PersonalData.refreshToken.reason: Extends the expiry of a DreamApply applicant's activation token and, per the spec, may move the application to state A; neither the old expiry nor the old state can be written back.
PersonalData.refreshToken.notes: The spec description says 'eventualmente aggiornando la domanda in stato A', so this is more than a token refresh.

PersonalData.updatePersonCompensatoryMea.reason: Sets the state and dates of a compensatory measure identified by its id; the previous values can be read and written back with the same call.
PersonalData.updatePersonCompensatoryMea.notes: Undo: before the call read getPersonCompensatoryMeasuresHandicapDeclaration(personId, handicapDeclarationId), take the element with handicapDeclarationMeasuresId = $args.handicapDeclarationMeasuresId, and call this operation again with its compensatoryMeasureState, measureStartDate and measureEndDate. Staff act on these measures, so use a test person.

Plans.postStudentPlan.reason: Inserts a new study plan for a student, possibly approving it and cancelling the valid one.

Questionnaires.savePageAnswers.reason: Saves the answers of one page of a questionnaire still being filled in; saving the page again with the previous answers puts it back until the questionnaire is confirmed.
Questionnaires.savePageAnswers.notes: Undo: before the call read getPage(studentId, activityChoiceId, questionnaireId, questionComponentId, pageId, userComponentId) and afterwards save its previous answers with this call. It is not clear that a page with no answers can be emptied again, and evaluation questionnaires gate exam booking, so use a compilation that will never be confirmed.

Questionnaires.setNewSurvey.reason: Starts a new questionnaire compilation for the student and returns its first page; no operation deletes a compilation.

Questionnaires.setVisibility.reason: Sets a visibility flag (visibleKind = visibleValue) on a user's compiled questionnaire; calling it again with the previous value puts it back.
Questionnaires.setVisibility.notes: Undo: the same call with the previous visibleValue. No operation exposes the flag, so whoever configures the test has to know its previous value (or the default); without it the undo cannot be set up. visibleKind has no documented values in the spec.

Records.importMinutes.reason: Imports exam minutes (verbali) as a batch job, creating or updating official exam records.

Records.uploadMinutesBlob.reason: Uploads the image of an exam minute and launches its acquisition.

Services.deleteAlias.reason: Removes a user's login alias. Services.insertUpdateAlias recreates it with the same value.
Services.deleteAlias.notes: Read the alias's expirationDate with Services.getAlias(userId) first and pass it to the undo. Until it is restored, the user can't sign in with the alias, so use a test user.

Services.getCodeFromId.reason: Translates codes into ids; sent as PUT but changes nothing.

Services.insertUpdateAlias.reason: Adds a login alias to a user, or updates its expiry date if it exists. Services.deleteAlias removes a new alias.
Services.insertUpdateAlias.notes: The undo is exact only for an alias the user didn't have, so check with getAlias first. For an existing alias, the call only changes its expiry date, and the undo calls insertUpdateAlias again with the old expirationDate. An alias is an extra login name, not a password. Use a test user.

Teachers.deleteLecturerSchedule.reason: Deletes office-hour slots of a lecturer (all of them when no day is given); they can be re-created with postLecturerSchedule from a prior read.
Teachers.deleteLecturerSchedule.notes: Undo: before the call read getLecturerSchedule(lecturerId, day) and afterwards re-post the deleted slots with postLecturerSchedule (day, startTime, endTime, placeDescription, note). The re-created slots get new lecturerScheduleId values. Always pass day and the slot's id or times, or every slot is deleted. Use a test lecturer.

Teachers.postLecturerSchedule.reason: Adds office-hour slots to a lecturer; deleteLecturerSchedule can remove them again by day and time.
Teachers.postLecturerSchedule.notes: The body is a list; undo each slot added, and pass lecturerResearchScheduleId (the new lecturerScheduleId from the result) when it can be told apart. Always pass day to the delete: without it every slot of the lecturer is deleted. Students can see the slot while it exists, so use a test lecturer.

Teachers.putLecturer.reason: Sets a lecturer's e-mail address; the previous address can be read from getLecturer and written back.
Teachers.putLecturer.notes: A null field is ignored, so a lecturer with no e-mail is put back by sending the special string '#!N!#'. Mail sent during the test would go to the test address, and the address may be synchronized elsewhere, so use a test lecturer.

Teachers.putLecturerNotes.reason: Inserts or updates a lecturer's notes (biographical, publications, curriculum, general); the previous notes can be read with getLecturerNotes and written back.
Teachers.putLecturerNotes.notes: Restore every field the call changed (biographicalNotes, publicationsNotes, curriculumNotes, lecturerNotes; same names in the read and the body). A null field is left unchanged, so a field that was empty before may need an empty string to clear. The notes are public on the lecturer's page while the test runs.

Teachers.putLecturerSchedule.reason: Updates one office-hour slot of a lecturer; the slot's previous values can be read with getLecturerSchedule and written back with the same call.
Teachers.putLecturerSchedule.notes: Undo: before the call read getLecturerSchedule(lecturerId) and keep the target slot (by lecturerScheduleId); afterwards call this operation with lecturerResearchScheduleId = that id and the old day, startTime, endTime, placeDescription and note. Clearing a field takes the string 'null' or -1. Students can see the change, so use a test lecturer.

Transcript.deleteRecordBookRecognitionRo.reason: Cancels a recognition on a record book row.
Transcript.deleteRecordBookRecognitionRo.notes: Re-inserting the recognition would record the grade again as a new official act. It does not restore the original.

Transcript.deleteRecordBookRow.reason: Deletes a row from a student's record book.
Transcript.deleteRecordBookRow.notes: postRecordBookRow can re-add the activity, but with a new activityChoiceId and without any outcome, bookings or attendance the deleted row carried.

Transcript.patchRecordBookRow.reason: Only sets the row's mission state (statoMissione). The previous state can be read with getRecordBookRow and written back with the same call.
Transcript.patchRecordBookRow.notes: missionState is an optional field, so it must be requested via optionalFields. Esse3 may refuse some mission-state transitions.

Transcript.postRecordBookRow.reason: Inserts a planned activity (year, offer/off-offer details, no grade) into a record book. Transcript.deleteRecordBookRow removes the new row.
Transcript.postRecordBookRow.notes: Undo: find the new row's activityChoiceId with Transcript.getRecordBookRows(matId), matching the inserted activity code (the response is empty), then call deleteRecordBookRow(matId, activityChoiceId). The record book is a staff-visible career record, so use a test career.

Transcript.putMassiveAttendance.reason: Sets or removes attendance for a list of students, overwriting attendance detections.

Transcript.putRecordBookRowRecognition.reason: Records a recognition or validation of an activity with grade and date.
Transcript.putRecordBookRowRecognition.notes: deleteRecordBookRecognitionRow cancels it, but a recognition records a grade and date, an official record staff act on.

Transcript.setManualAttendance.reason: Sets or removes attendance on a record book row, recording teacher and date.
Transcript.setManualAttendance.notes: Removing attendance (staSceCod P) does not erase the detection data or audit. Attendance is an official record, so it stays irreversible even though the same call can flip it back.

TuitionFees.cancelInvoice.reason: Cancels an invoice, which cannot be restored.

TuitionFees.postAcquireExemptions.reason: Imports fee exemptions, a batch job that changes students' fees.

TuitionFees.postAcquireScholarshipOutcom.reason: Imports the outcomes of regional scholarships, a batch job that changes students' fees.

TuitionFees.postCreateStudentInvoice.reason: Creates an invoice for a student, a payment request they see.
TuitionFees.postCreateStudentInvoice.notes: cancelInvoice can cancel the invoice, but the cancelled invoice stays on record and the student has already seen a payment request.

TuitionFees.postInitPagoPaTransaction.reason: Opens a pagoPA payment session for an invoice, which can block other payment attempts until it expires.

TuitionFees.postInvoiceAttachmentMetadat.reason: Attaches a document to an invoice, which staff see; there is no matching delete.
TuitionFees.postInvoiceAttachmentMetadat.notes: The insert returns the upload URL only in a Location header. Attachments.deleteUploadedAttachment can abort a pending upload, but the spec does not say this removes the attachment metadata row, so no exact undo is documented. Could be promoted to reversible if aborting is confirmed to remove it.

TuitionFees.postNotifyStatus.reason: Updates the status of a payment transaction in Esse3.
TuitionFees.postNotifyStatus.notes: Payment-gateway callback: a test call could mark a transaction as paid or failed without a real payment.

TuitionFees.postPayInvoice.reason: Records the payment of an invoice.

TuitionFees.putPrintPagoPANotice.reason: Returns the pagoPA payment notice PDF of an existing invoice, as the student portal does when the student clicks 'print notice'.
TuitionFees.putPrintPagoPANotice.notes: The spec only says it returns the notice ('Restituisce l'avviso di pagamento pagoPA'). At most, the first print assigns the invoice's IUV/debt position. That position belongs to an invoice that already exists, the step is idempotent, and the student would trigger it by viewing the notice, so nothing needs undoing.

TuitionFees.putRequestPaymentStatus.reason: Asks pagoPA for the payment status of an invoice and updates Esse3 only if the payment really happened, the same reconciliation Esse3's own scheduled jobs do.
TuitionFees.putRequestPaymentStatus.notes: It cannot mark an unpaid invoice as paid. It only brings Esse3 in line with pagoPA. If the owner sees any reconciliation as an official-record write, downgrade to irreversible.

TuitionFees.rejectExemption.reason: Rejects a student's fee exemption, a decision staff and the student see.

Users.postUserSignatureData.reason: Imports users' signature data (batch update of user records).

Users.postUserSignatureDataCsv.reason: Imports users' signature data from a CSV (batch update of user records).

Users.putCieCode.reason: Associates CIE credentials with a user account, changing how the user logs in, with no undo.
Users.putCieCode.notes: It sets the code only if none is associated, and no operation removes it. It changes how the user signs in (credentials).

Users.putSpidCode.reason: Associates SPID credentials with a user account, changing how the user logs in, with no undo.
Users.putSpidCode.notes: It sets the code only if none is associated, and no operation removes it. It changes how the user signs in (credentials).
